Name: Animal Skin Preview
Author: iwilleatyourdog
Description:
[font=Arial]If you happen to use mods that include multiple skins for one animal, you might have noticed that you can't really know which skin is being purcharsed. This mod basically shows skin Id and the animal's sprite in the left bottom corner of the screen.

[/font]Other mods used in media: 
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20044]Elle's Cuter Barn Animals[/url] by [url=http://next.nexusmods.com/profile/junimods/mods?gameId=1303]junimods[/url]
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20043]Elle's Cuter Coop Animals[/url] by [url=http://next.nexusmods.com/profile/junimods/mods?gameId=1303]junimods[/url]
[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39210](CP) Truffle Foxes - Pig Replacement or New Animal[/url] by [url=http://next.nexusmods.com/profile/iwilleatyourdog?gameId=1303]iwilleatyourdog[/url]
